verdict.rationale: MotherDuck documents Shares that grant read access to specific users, roles or accounts in an organization, and that can be shared publicly with any MotherDuck account in the same cloud region, including users outside the organization. Recipients attach a share by its md:_share path rather than receiving an export. Cross-organization sharing is documented only as public sharing within the same region, and the docs never explicitly state that shares are live or zero-copy. missing for 10: explicit documentation of live/zero-copy share semantics, targeted (non-public) cross-organization or cross-region sharing, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can share live datasets with another account or organization without copying data or building an export pipeline

citations.quote: Grant read access to users or roles for multi-tenant applications and collaboration.
Sharing data with specific preset roles or accounts in your organization.
Sharing data publicly with anyone with a MotherDuck account in the same cloud region as your Organization, including users outside your Organization.
Limit which tables and views a Share exposes with an include pattern.
